description: The deepest mask Rust allows: after the driver cancels t.a at 50, its masked section nests 64 masks (MAX_MASK_DEPTH, `assert!(mask_depth < MAX_MASK_DEPTH)` in Cx::masked, cx.rs:3323, admits the 64th). Inside them the checkpoint returns ASX_OK and is_cancel_requested reports true; the unmasked checkpoint after them acknowledges the cancel.
